Declare token-level sequence tagger output and decode metadata.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Text](../categories/text.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `SequenceTagOutput` |
| Search words | sequence, tag, output, ner, decode |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Token Logits** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Per-token logits [batch, seq_len, num_tags] |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Predictions** | Tensor | No | 1 | Token-level prediction tensor |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| num_tags | `num_tags` | Integer | `0` |   | The run | Number of BIO tags (0 = infer) |
| tag_vocab_file | `tag_vocab_file` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Tag vocabulary file. |
| decode_scheme | `decode_scheme` | Choice | `BIO` | `BIO` | The run | Decode scheme. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
